heard: Four astronauts will soon travel farther from Earth than any humans ever. Artemis II is NASA's first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years. Since 1972, every human spaceflight has remained confined to low Earth orbit. But Commander Reed Weissman and his crew will first climb into high Earth orbit. Powered by a European service module, their spacecraft, named Integrity, will reach between 44,000 and 46,000 miles. Pilot Victor Glover will then guide them on a slingshot around the lunar far side. Mission specialist Jeremy Hansen will be the first non-American to leave Earth orbit. This 10-day flight into deep space finally shatters the distance record held by Apollo 13. By 2026, these four will travel farther from Earth than any humans ever.
differences: 'reid wiseman' heard as 'reed weissman' after 'orbit but commander'
